headline: Warburg buys DICVS from promoters; eyes electronics scale-up

highlights: Warburg will acquire the promoters’ entire 38.5% stake through its affiliate Topaz Terrace Investments for up to ~Rs17bn (Link), implying an equity valuation of ~Rs43bn for DICVS (Rs354/share), which translates into ~18x FY28E PER and ~1.8x DICVS FY26 revenue of ~Rs24bn.

We view the development positively, as the demerger creates two focused businesses with distinct growth and capital-allocation priorities, while placing the higher-growth electronics franchise with a global investor who can support its next phase of expansion.
Meanwhile, the Mohan family will retain control of the remaining Pricol business, comprising Actuation, Control, and Fluid Management Systems (ACFMS) and polymer operations.
We build in 21%/24%/26% consolidated revenue/EBITDA/EPS CAGR over FY26-29E.
